text: A block of mass 15 kg slides down a line of greatest slope of an inclined plane. The top of the plane is
at a vertical height of 1.6 m above the level of the bottom of the plane. The speed of the block at the
top of the plane is 2 m s and the speed of the block at the bottom of the plane is 4 m s .
Find the work done against the resistance to motion of the block. [4]
